terms.definition: Agent governance, state, migration, and verification framework.
The single authoritative implementation in the vHarness source repository.
A repository adopting or already using vHarness.
Host-owned source, documents, data, and business directories.
Agent.md, _System, and governed capabilities installed in a host.
SOPs, manuals, references, and developer-managed material in _Dev.
The registered current location for a framework artifact.
A previous or foreign framework path; not an automatic deletion instruction.
Generated artifact carrying source and version provenance.
Host-specific governance or tooling preserved outside the standard set.
A governance progress record; never a top-level business container.
A machine-readable execution contract with frozen input fingerprints.
Transactional application of an approved Migration Plan.
A Migration Run that repairs a legacy upgrade result.
Assertions that must hold before and after migration.
